newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian telecom to expand mobile phone systems.
newsitem.headline: Croatian telecom to expand mobile phone systems.

text.p: Croatia's two mobile phone networks, Mobitel and Cronet, plan to invest 150 million German marks to improve their systems and double the number of their subscribers in 1997, state news agency HINA said.
Both networks are operated by state telecom monopoly HPT.
Mobitel will add capacity for 62,000 new clients in the next few days, HINA quoted Mladen Sutalo, deputy head of HPT, as saying. Mobitel currently has 53,000 subscribers.

Digital Cronet GSM network would soon get a new telephone exchange, expanding its capacity to 70,000 users, Sutalo said. Cronet's present capacity is for 30,000 customers, but the network has only half that number now.
"In 1997 only, 150 million marks will be invested in both networks," Sutalo said, adding HPT has so far invested some 100 million marks.
The coverage of the entire Croatian territory with a quality infrastructure would require investments totalling 400 million marks, he said.
HPT is the most lucrative Croatian company with some 331.8 million kuna ($61 million) net profit in 1995. (( -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ))
